caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a rectangular top and raised feet, rendered in shades of brown and black. The cabinet’s front features intricate geometric and carved details, including a prominent central panel with a raised polygonal shape and subtle inscriptions. There are four turned, baluster-like columns, two on either side of the front panel, and a horizontal row of small round knobs near the base. The side panel is decorated with a repeating black pattern resembling stylized vines or fleur-de-lis against the brown wood. The cabinet stands on four spherical black feet, and the image background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects. The artist's name, Bernard Krieger, is written in cursive in the lower left corner.
title: Cabinet for Storage
